_comment: Functions ported from Sam4.exe to the other builds by tools/sigscan.py (unique wildcarded signature). Source evidence in docs/re/R1_vtable.md.

engine_alloc._note: FUN(size, tag) allocator: 2nd direct call in viewport_render_vr

holder_create._note: render-target holder (re)create: (holder, gfx, w, h, fmt=2, 0, flags, 0); flag 4 = double width

holder_get._note: holder -> texture wrapper; device eye RT = *(wrapper+8)

set_playing_in_vr._note: native CPlayerSimulationData::SetPlayingInVR(psd, int): 12th direct call of bind_local_user_psd, the only native caller (passes 0) (R3 s1)

bind_local_user_psd._note: binds the local user to its psd; only native caller of set_playing_in_vr, passes 0 (R3 s1)

vrd_init._note: CPlayerVRData init (vrd, player); two unguarded device slot 0x208 calls (R3 s7)

vrd_controller_world._note: CPlayerVRData controller world placement (vrd, P7* out, role): 2nd direct call of the script wrapper (R3 s2)

client_action_vr._note: ClientActionVR net stub + apply; writes player+0x25c8 unguarded (R3 s4)

client_action._note: desktop ClientAction net stub + apply (player vt+0x1298) (R3 s4)

send_vr_action._note: native ClientActionVR sender (player), builds args from vrd (R3 s4)

aim_writer._note: player aim/target writer (R8 s4); its calls to the shared return-1 stub gate the barrel ray (R8 s8 A)

crosshair_render._note: CWeaponCrosshairHudElement vt+0x80 render (R8 s1; SM = slot 0x80 of vtable 0x1415e1c70)

main_loop._note: main loop; call [rax+0x50] (Render) at +0x25c, the only caller passing inVR=0 (R10)

wvb_animate._note: CWheeledVehicleBehavior animate (vt+0xa8): writes the steering-wheel bone into the vehicle bone follower (R7 s2)

bone_world._note: bone world placement (P7* out, entity*, IDENT bone) (R7 s3)

attach_world._note: attachment world placement (entity*, out*, IDENT attachment) (R7 s3)

ident_ctor._note: IDENT from C string (IDENT* out, const char*) (R7 s3)

follower_setrot._note: CBonePathFollower set bone rotation (follower*, IDENT bone, quat*) (R7 s2)

euler_quat._note: Euler (H,P,B radians) -> quaternion (quat* out, float3*): 8th direct call of wvb_animate (R7 s2)

bpf_ctor._note: CBonePathFollower ctor: 11th direct call of the script CreateScriptedBonePathFollower (R9 s3)

mh_register._note: register motion handler (renderable, handler, 0): 12th direct call (R9 s3)

mh_base_ctor._note: CMotionHandler base ctor (writes the base vtable): 1st call of bpf_ctor (R9 s3)

vrd_tick._note: CPlayerVRData per-tick step (vrd): hands, handlers (R3 s6, R9 s1)

vr_ctrl_model_pose._note: per-hand VR controller model pose/draw (hand obj, drawport, ?, ?, alt): reads the model at +0x70/+0x78 without a null check (lab crash 2026-10-24)

segment_cast._note: SegmentCast(res, world, from*, to*, CName, CName) (R12 s5)

cast_result_ctor._note: cast result ctor (0x1f0 bytes; +0x98 radius, +0x00 ignored owner handle) (R12 s5)

cast_result_dtor._note: cast result member dtor at result+0xa8 (R12 s2.1 swing test tail)

knife_swing_test._note: CMacheteWeaponEntity swing test (weapon, stepArg): 6th direct call of the knife step in all builds (R12 s2.1)

weapon_params._note: weapon params getter (weapon, ref*) -> params; release the ref (R12 s2.1)

damage_ctor._note: CDamage ctor: 17th direct call of the knife swing test (R12 s3)

hdr_targets._note: HDR 3D canvas allocation (gfx...): creates 'HDR 3D canvas' into drawport global 0x1422d7358 (R13 s4.1)

pp_dispatch._note: post-processing dispatch (gfx, hdrCanvas, flags, ...): last point at render resolution before post FX (R13 s4.4)

vrd_head_world._note: CPlayerVRData head world placement (vrd, out P7) = anchor o device slot 0x80 (R3 s3)

sniping_step._note: CSnipingWeaponMode step (vt+0x20): aim ratio, zoom handler on/off (R14 s2.1)

barrel_placement._note: GetBarrelPlacement(weapon, P7 out, ctx, CName attachment, 0, 0, 1) (R14 s4)

fov_base._note: player base FOV in degrees (desktop; R14 s2.5)

barrel_ctx._note: no-argument getter whose result is GetBarrelPlacement's 3rd argument (script wrapper 0x1402d1ab0)

mode_params._note: weapon mode params getter (mode) (2nd call of the sniping step; R14 s2.1)

weapon_step._note: CWeaponEntity step: native two-hand grip from the other hand's fire bit (R15 s4.2)

mi_anim_queue._note: model instance -> animation queue (mi, create) (R15 s1.2)

queue_add_handler._note: add a CMotionHandler to an animation queue (R15 s1.4)

weapon_placement._note: weapon model world matrix (VR: controller / two-hand blend) (R15 s1.3)

controller_draw._note: CVRController draw (ctrl, r, a, b) (R15 s2)

draw_model._note: draw a model instance at a P7 (r, a, b, mi, P7, world) (R15 s1.4)

new_model._note: allocate + construct a model instance (R15 s1.4)

model_set_config._note: model instance: set configuration (mi, cfg) (R15 s1.2)

hide_right_ctrl_script._note: add rcx, <right CVRController offset>; call hide_controller (R15 s5)

entity_time._note: entity simulation time (entity, out) -> &out; the weapon step stamps grip changes with it (+0x288) (R15 s4.2); 26th direct call of the weapon step

gadget_launch_activate._note: CLaunchGadgetProjectile weapon mode activation (vt+0x50): copies the targeting quat to +0x20, start +0x30, speed +0x3c, lifetime +0x40 (R12 s8)

gadget_launch_event._note: launch mode anim event handler (vt+0x180): Throw/Fire -> gadget_launch (R12 s8.3)

gadget_launch._note: CLaunchGadgetProjectile spawn (mode) from the Throw/Fire anim event, authority only; reads mode +0x20 quat, +0x3c speed, +0x40 lifetime (R12 s8.3)

player_view._note: player vt+0x340 view placement (player, out QuatVect, ?, mode): mode 0 = camera (head world with vrd), 1 = +0xf3c (R3 s2, R8 s4)

aoe_targeting_step._note: CAOETargeting weapon mode step (vt+0x28): arc from player vt+0x340 mode 0; stores +0x30 valid, +0x34 launch, +0x50 speed, +0x54 time (R12 s8.1)

gadget_holder_model._note: CGadgetHolderWeaponEntity vt+0x668 first-person model (gip at holder+0x380): identifies a holder by its vtable slot (R12 s7, s10)

gadget_holder_use._note: CGadgetHolderWeaponEntity vt+0x8a0 use: consume, recoil anim, Fire (R12 s7)

gadget_holder_step._note: CGadgetHolderWeaponEntity step: quick-use auto-fire (+0x390, +0x378) then the generic step (R12 s7)

gadget_holder_ready._note: GadgetHolder ready-to-use test (holder) -> int; the quick-use auto-fire waits for it (R12 s7); 2nd direct call of the holder step

giveall_gadgets_script._note: cheats menu: mov edx,[rip+flags]; mov ecx,edx; or ecx,4 - the give-all flags global (GACF_GADGETS = 4); lab_giveall sets it

weapons_restore._note: restore the weapons remembered before a gadget (player +0x22ac right / +0x22b0 left; SM +0x22b4/+0x22b8) after a quick use; the mod reads the two offsets from its first compares

select_weapons_net._note: weapon wheel dual commit (player, idxRight, idxLeft): net call + 0x140493b70 (R3 s6)

aoe_target_check._note: targeting mode target check (mode) -> int: 0 = invalid / too close (the activation then shows ETRSMessages.GadgetTargetTooClose); 5th direct call of the launch activation (R12 s8.2)

crosshair_show._note: crosshair show predicate (only reader of hud_bShowCrosshair): returns 0 for any player with vrd (+0xa0 cmp [rbx+vrd],0; jne) (R8 addendum A1)

wheel_render._note: CWeaponSelectionWheelHudElement vt+0x80 render (also reads the selection sticks) (R16 s2.2); identifies the wheel element by its vtable slot

wheel_dummy_command._note: CMSDummyWeaponSelectionController vt+0x138 OnCommand: the menu screen the wheel pushes; identifies it as the top screen (R16 s1.1)

hud_element_render._note: per-HUD-element render (ctx, element): ctx[7] &vr, ctx[8] &anchor P7; VR model = anchor * params(+0x18 quat, +0x28 pos) * stretch(+0x34); params = element+0x18 (R16 s2.1)

wheel_pp._note: weapon wheel vt+0xc8: queues the wheel post-processing preset (world blur/tint) while visible (R16 s2.3)

hud_canvas_flush._note: HUD canvas flush (canvas = *(hud+0xb0), gfx): draws and frees every queued quad/text entry with the matrix stored at entry creation; safe mid-loop (R8 A6)

simple_element_draw._note: CSimpleHudElement draw: overwrites the 2D object matrix with its own transform and draws immediately (health, armour, ...) (R8 A6)

hud_render._note: CHud render (hud, viewId, viewEntity, fov): +0x1e1 calls the device+0x08 (immersive) getter that selects the 3D VR HUD branch (R8 A5, R16 s2.1)

vr_hand_use._note: CPlayerVRData hand use (vrd, hand): copies the hand ray hit into the aim target, sets player+0x2504 and runs the use action (plcmdUse / melee kills) (R8 s5)

generic_melee_step._note: CGenericMeleeWeaponEntity step (signs, poles): weapon step then the swing test (R12 s2.2)

generic_melee_swing_test._note: CGenericMeleeWeaponEntity canned swing test (body/view arc; skipped for VR owners) (R12 s2.2)

crosshair_ring._note: crosshair dispersion ring/quad draw ring(elem, view, proj, float scale, u32 colour, const float* T, float D, tex*), called once from the crosshair render (R8 s1, A7.2 R5)

other_hand_weapon._note: weapon -> the owner's other-hand weapon (en_bRightHandWeapon ? left : right); the ring takes max(spread) of both (R8 s1, A7.2 G2)

gwa_step._note: CPSGenericWeaponAnimation vt+0x48 step: creates the dummy weapon, plays the anim, schedules CEntityState::Return after its length (R17 s1.6)

aq_set_speed._note: void(aq, float): anim queue speed multiplier, rebases playing anims so their time is preserved; never 0 (R17 s3.1)

aq_get_speed._note: float(aq): anim queue speed multiplier (R17 s3.1)

gsae_fire._note: CGlobalScriptAnimEvent fire (vt+0x18): posts the global script event (ArtifactBroken) (R17 s1.7)

make_handle._note: void(handle16* out, obj, type = obj->vt[0](obj)) (R17 s1.6)

timer_cancel._note: void(world, const handle16*): cancel the state's scheduled calls (R17 s1.6)

aq_anim_length._note: float(aq, IDENT, int): anim length in seconds (R17 s1.6)

state_schedule._note: void(state, float delay, cb, const char* name): CEntityState::Return timer (R17 s1.6)

vr_netricsa_act._note: Fusion VR wheel Netricsa button action (btn, hand) (R18 s2.1)

vr_quicksave_act._note: Fusion VR wheel QuickSave/Load button action (btn, hand); btn+0x40 1 save / 0 load (vrwheel+0x58 deferred) (R18 s2.1)

vr_menu_avail._note: Fusion VR wheel Menu button availability (btn) (R18 s2.1)

vr_netricsa_avail._note: Fusion VR wheel Netricsa button availability (btn) (R18 s2.1)

vr_qs_avail._note: Fusion VR wheel QuickSave/Load availability (btn): saving allowed (not MP) and player alive (R18 s2.1)

vr_wheel_tick._note: Fusion VR wheel tick (vrwheel): deferred quick load (R18 s2.1)

player_key._note: (player, int* key) controller key of a player (R18 s2.4)

quick_load._note: (menuMgr = pi+0xb8, int* key, int) quick load / confirm dialog (R18 s2.5)

hud_text._note: HUD text (batch, gfx, CString*, TextParams*, uint64 xy, float alpha) (R18 s3.2)

hud_box9._note: HUD 9-slice box (batch, gfx, CTexture*, float rect[4], ARGB) (R18 s3.2)

menu_open_hand._note: (pi, hand, const char* menu "" = default in-game menu, float fade 0.5, 0, 0): what the Fusion VR Menu button runs after committing the hand pick (R18 s2.1)

xpad_control_markup._note: XInput pad device vt+0x38: CString* (self, CString* out, int control) -> the icon set glyph markup; self+0x20 = XInput user (R19 s2.1)

router_control_markup._note: "GamepadX" input router vt+0x38: forwards to the last used pad (R19 s1.3); identifies the router device

command_markup._note: command_markup(CString* out, bindings, const INDEX* piDevice, ident idCommand): prompt text of a command for one device (R19 s1.1)

control_markup._note: control_markup(CString* out, const INDEX* piDevice, INDEX control): g_devices / count are its first rip loads (R19 s1.1)

device_switch._note: (pi, bindings, ...): sets pi+0xb0 to the last used input device, which picks prompt glyph variants (R19 s1.2)

script_ctx._note: per-thread engine context (TLS); ctx+0xa8 = executing CLuaScriptInterface (R20 s2.3)

lua_exec_string._note: int (lsi, ctx, const char* src, uint flags): runs Lua source as a scheduler coroutine in that script context (R20 s2.2); lab_lua

aux_holder_update._note: CAuxButtonHolder vt+0x20 (bar, dp): per-frame menu button bar; picks each button's mode record by g_inputMode (R19 s8)

input_mode_get._note: IDENT* (IDENT* out): *out = g_inputMode; first insn mov rax,[rip+g_inputMode] (R19 s8.4)

aux_shortcut._note: (bar, idx, menuCmd, mode, literal): the button's mode-record shortcut; Gamepad = the menu command expanded (R19 s8.2)

abh_find._note: (bar, idx, mode) -> CAuxButtonModeData (+8 shortcut CString) (R19 s8.5)

hud_text_centred._note: HUD text centred on xy, same arguments as hud_text (R18 s7)

hud_layout_map._note: HUD layout map: virtual 640x480 point -> canvas pixels with the engine safe area (R22)

gfx_safe_area._note: float* (float out[2]): the engine safe area (clamped 0.85..1) (R22 s0)

vr_loco_in_air._note: (vrd) -> airborne for long: reads player+0x1d0 (en_pbo) without a null check; crashes while riding (R21 s3)

gfx_text._note: gfx text draw (gfx, CString*, xyz*, colour): the HUD flush draws each queued text record with it (R18 s7.2); diagnostic hook only

execute_view._note: execute a view's render commands (the eye's scene, then its post-processing): the upscaler LOD bias window (R23 s4.2)

is_third_person_view._note: BOOL (CPuppetEntity*): puppet vt+0xdf0, the view gate; while riding the seat ALLOW bits, else en_bAvatarViewMode. False = vt+0xdf8 uses vt+0x340 mode 0 (vrd head) (R24)

get_camera_mode._note: int (CPlayerActorPuppetEntity*): PCM_* from the profile/prj (riding) view option, stored in en_pcmPlayerCameraMode (R24)

nm_script_rpc_ctor._note: CNMScriptRPC ctor (msg[0x30]): +0x18 reliable, +0x1c name hash, +0x20 CStaticStackArray<UBYTE> args (R13 s2.3)

nm_script_rpc_process._note: void (ctx, netif, msg): CNMScriptRPC::Process, hash -> worldGlobals[name] (R13 s2.3); detoured for the mod's hashes

rpc_args_append._note: (CStaticStackArray<UBYTE>*, const void*, int len): append bytes, engine allocator (R13 s2.2)

pi_world._note: CWorld* (project instance): the current world (R13 s6)

net_client_send._note: client netif vt+0xe0 (netif, msg): enqueue to the server connection (R13 s2.4)

net_server_broadcast._note: server netif vt+0xe0 (netif, msg): to every in-game client while +0xd794 (R13 s2.4)

net_server_send_one._note: server netif vt+0xe8 (netif, msg, const int* slot): to one client, no gate (R13 s2.4)
